[ BODY-LINK PROTOCOL v2 ]

UART 250000 8N1 between ESP32 and Uno. Frame AA len type seq payload crc8: len = payload bytes (max 48), seq = sender's counter, CRC-8 poly 0x07 init 0x00 over len..payload, little-endian fields.

Master (ESP32 or bench) sends HEARTBEAT every 100 ms; the Uno stops network motion after 300 ms without a valid frame and DRIVE after 300 ms without a new DRIVE. Handshake: HELLO_REQ → HELLO → HELLO_ACK (proto must match).

Main frames

FrameTypeFieldsExampleBytes (hex)
HEARTBEAT0x01esp_ms u32seq=0, esp_ms=1000aa 04 01 00 e8 03 00 00 35
HELLO_REQ0x03-seq=1aa 00 03 01 38
HELLO0x80fw u16, proto u8, caps u8, reset_reason u8, commit u32seq=0, fw=256, proto=2, caps=0, reset_reason=1, commit=0x1a2b3c4daa 09 80 00 00 01 02 00 01 4d 3c 2b 1a df
HELLO_ACK0x02proto u8seq=2, proto=2aa 01 02 02 02 e4
DRIVE0x10src u8, v i8, w i8seq=3, src=1, v=40, w=0aa 03 10 03 01 28 00 1e
STOP0x12src u8seq=4, src=1aa 01 12 04 01 31
ACK0x81ack_seq u8, status u8seq=1, ack_seq=4, status=0aa 02 81 01 04 00 dc
CAM_JOY0x20x i8, y i8, active u8seq=5, x=0, y=50, active=1aa 03 20 05 00 32 01 85
CAM_HOME0x23-seq=6aa 00 23 06 83
OWNER_HINT0x42owner u8seq=7, owner=1aa 01 42 07 01 2a

All frames

TypeFrameDirNotes
0x01HEARTBEATESP32→UnoKeep-alive every 100 ms
0x02HELLO_ACKESP32→UnoSent after ENVELOPE is acknowledged; the Uno marks the link synced.
0x03HELLO_REQESP32→UnoAsk the Uno to re-send HELLO.
0x04ESP_ACKESP32→UnoAcknowledges Uno-originated requests (WIFI_RESET_REQ, ADMIN_RESET_REQ).
0x10DRIVEESP32→Unostreaming - Streamed drive (phones <= 20 Hz; the bridge motion service 50 Hz)
0x11DRIVE_RATEESP32→Unostreaming - Streamed drive with closed-loop yaw rate.
0x12STOPESP32→Unoack - Immediate smooth stop; cancels primitives
0x13TURNESP32→Unoack - Gyro turn by/to an angle; radius 0 = spin in place.
0x14MOVEESP32→Unoack - Drive a distance with heading hold (needs encoders).
0x15CANCELESP32→Unoack - Cancel the running primitive.
0x20CAM_JOYESP32→Unostreaming - Absolute joystick camera; release returns home unless locked.
0x21CAM_SETESP32→Unoack
0x22CAM_NUDGEESP32→Unoack
0x23CAM_HOMEESP32→Unoack
0x24CAM_LOCKESP32→Unoack
0x30LEDESP32→Unoack - Custom LED layer (priority 4); alarms override.
0x31SOUNDESP32→Unoack
0x32TONEESP32→Unoack - Custom tone sequence, up to 10 notes.
0x33AUDIO_MODEESP32→Unoack
0x40BRAKEESP32→Unoack - Obstacle brake on/off; refused (ENVELOPE_LOCKED) while lock_brake.
0x41ENVELOPEESP32→Unoack - Speed/accel caps
0x42OWNER_HINTESP32→UnoNetwork owner for LED colour; re-sent on change and after re-sync.
0x43SAFETY_OVERRIDEESP32→Unoack - Safety Override on/off (human only; spec 02 A6.1)
0x50SETTING_SETESP32→Unoack
0x51SETTING_GETESP32→Unoack - Reply is SETTING_VALUE.
0x52SETTINGS_SAVEESP32→Unoack - Persist to EEPROM (deferred until stopped); settings_saved event when done.
0x60CALIBRATEESP32→Unoack - Run/cancel a calibration motion script; Uno streams CAL_DATA, ESP32 computes
0x61PROFILEESP32→Unoack
0x80HELLOUno→ESP32Sent at boot every 500 ms until HELLO_ACK, and on HELLO_REQ.
0x81ACKUno→ESP32
0x90TELEM_FASTUno→ESP3250 Hz motion telemetry (spec 02 §E4).
0x91TELEM_SLOWUno→ESP321 Hz health/status telemetry.
0x92EVENTUno→ESP32Event kind from events.yaml with a/b packing.
0x93SETTING_VALUEUno→ESP32
0x94CAL_RESULTUno→ESP32Script progress/done/fail.
0x95CAL_DATAUno→ESP32Raw calibration samples at 50 Hz; per-script v[0..7] layout in docs/lld/protocol-generator-lld.md (CAL_DATA channel layouts).
0x96WIFI_RESET_REQUno→ESP32ack - Mode button held 5 s at boot; re-sent every 500 ms until ESP_ACK.
0x97ADMIN_RESET_REQUno→ESP32ack - Mode button held 15 s at boot; re-sent every 500 ms until ESP_ACK.

ACK status byte

0 OK · 1 NOT_OWNER · 2 BLOCKED · 3 UNAVAILABLE · 4 ENVELOPE_LOCKED · 5 BUSY · 6 INVALID_COMMAND · 7 CANCELLED · 8 TIMEOUT · 9 STALLED · 10 LINK_LOST · 11 SETTING_UNKNOWN · 12 SETTING_OUT_OF_RANGE · 13 SETTINGS_SAVE_BUSY · 14 CAL_PRECONDITION · 15 CAL_FAILED · 16 CAL_CANCELLED · 17 INTERNAL · 18 ROLE_FORBIDDEN
